decision: Implement the complete bounded 25-page add9/minorAdd9 collection; preserve original N2D URLs.
decisionEvidence: Product coverage and current reusable architecture, not proof of SEO-optimal quantity.
rootPolicy: 12 reference spellings, not 12 unique written keys; no enharmonic alias URL multiplication.
actualCountRule: Set union of actual repository business routes and these 25 URLs. Do not hardcode counts if Scales or other work changed the baseline.
idempotentRule: If any of these routes already exists locally, update it in place; never create a second variant.
